title: Deterministic Console score-edit audit message block
description: Implement deterministic Console score-edit audit rendering so candidate version details and link are always present without relying on model prose. Add runtime audit payload, deterministic postprocessing message injection, and focused tests.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting implementation: add deterministic score-edit audit summary (including relative version link path), capture via runtime context from execute_tactus, and inject a fixed audit block into the final Console assistant message. Then add regression tests.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Integration run (local console worker + Chrome): (1) underspecified user prompt now asks for scorecard/score clarification instead of guessing; (2) deterministic score-edit audit block appears in assistant response with candidate version link and compact audit metadata in execute_tactus tool response; (3) guidelines update request was blocked by automatic guidelines validation and did not mutate. Next: improve guidelines update path so a high-level wording tweak can auto-preserve existing rubric structure while still validating before save.

comments.text: Addressed candidate-version link gap in assistant body text. Root cause: deterministic score-edit block already had a link, but model-generated prose line like "New candidate version: `...`" stayed plain text.
